How to play

Add a task, then swipe the ball forward and release. Your speed at release sets its momentum. A slow roll may stop short; a fast one can overshoot.

Finish the revealed task to bank its points. A miss earns 10 points.

Your first completed task each local calendar day earns a streak bonus: 20 points on day 1, then 10 more per consecutive day, up to 80. Missing a day resets your streak, but you keep your points and cosmetics.

Spend banked points in the cosmetic shop. Your total earned score stays the same when you spend. Everything saves in this browser on this device.
